name: Bitterroot River (Stevensville)
blurb: Gentle valley float with Bitterroot peaks for a backdrop. Infamous for shifting logjams.

sections.notes: Channels braid and wood moves every year — heads-up floating.
Check recent obstruction reports — strainers are common here.
Last valley miles into town. Still woody. Stay off new side channels you can't see through.
sections.accessReview: The intended Buckhouse Bridge take-out and legal river-side landing have not been confirmed. Choose another documented exit before planning this stretch.
